name: Haus Seppl
beschreibung: The hotel Haus Seppl is located on a quiet side street in Tirol, surrounded by the Alpine landscape. The rooms are furnished with local wood furniture and have a balcony or terrace. In the surrounding area there are marked hiking trails in summer and groomed ski slopes in winter. The house offers a wellness area with Sauna and steam bath. The breakfast buffet includes regional products; in the evening, dishes of Tiroler Küche are served. The staff provides information about excursion destinations and activities in the region. Public transport connections are available, and the town center is within walking distance.
